question: Does the byte-identical current InputOwner v10 verify release of an admitted held key after an observed A-to-B X11 focus transfer, before B receives another matching KeyPress?
hypothesis: With autorepeat established independently, the owner detects the focus change on its bounded queue wait, emits KeyRelease, and verifies the key is absent from the X server keymap before B receives an additional matching KeyPress.
fixture: One private Xvfb 800x600x24 server in a pinned WSLc image containing Python 3.12, python-xlib, Xvfb and xset; two bare InputOutput X windows; repeat 100ms/20ms on the private server; actual current input_owner_v10.py; no WM, model, app, or game.

design.control: Set and read back autorepeat on private Xvfb with xset r rate 100 20; XTEST key-down on A held 240ms, collect matching KeyPress events, send KeyRelease, verify query_keymap reports key up
design.trial: Owner admits one key-down on A; B reader selects KeyPress/KeyRelease on the exact connection it drains and confirms this before the external focus B request; owner release is recorded; after a 100ms settling interval the reader performs XSync and a final drain; a pump exception, absent subscription, incomplete fence, or post-release dequeue of a matching press is HOLD.
design.output: candidate process writes raw.json only; a separate auditor process reads only that raw file and writes classification.json; retain both processes' exits/stdout/stderr

primary_decision.scoped_pass: Positive control succeeds; A-to-B focus transfer is read back; owner logs verified focus_changed release; server keymap is empty; the B reader subscribed before transfer, completes an exception-free XSync fence and final drain; no matching B KeyPress is observed from focus request through verified release, and no ambiguous matching press is dequeued after release.
primary_decision.counterexample: one or more matching B KeyPress events are received after the focus-change request begins and before owner release verification, including while requester awaits XSync
primary_decision.hold: Release verification, source identity, event ordering, same-connection subscription, exception-free fence/final drain, or timing certainty is missing or inconsistent.
primary_decision.stop: positive repeat control does not show at least two presses and a verified release

H: Observed focus loss leads the current owner to verified release before the new focus receives autorepeat; any ambiguous late event cannot be reported as a pass.
T: One bounded CPU/Xvfb candidate, one independent auditor, zero retries; one A-to-B focus transfer; same-connection B event selection before transfer; XSync final queue drain after 100ms settling; any matching press dequeued after release is HOLD.
D: Classify raw.json independently; require verified=true exactly, same-reader subscription before transfer, no pump exception, completed XSync fence and final drain; use monotonic receipt order and HOLD on matching presses dequeued after release.
C: Private WSLc Xvfb; Python Xlib; byte-identical current InputOwner v10; two bare X11 windows; separate reader connection both selects B events and drains them; delegating proxy timestamps owner focus queries and may perturb scheduling.
U: One scheduler-sensitive Linux/WSL Xvfb trial. Receipt time is a host monotonic dequeue time; if a matching B press is dequeued after release its server arrival side of the boundary is ambiguous and result is HOLD. No real desktop, application, gameplay or GPU claim.
